text:
Marta: evening handoff — quick watchlist for the night shift. nothing critical but a few flaky signals to keep an eye on:
• encoder pool (eu-west-1): tail latency drifting ~7–12ms above baseline on short sequences, started ~3h ago. not triggering SLO yet but visible on p50->p95 spread.
• prefix-cache jitter: occasional 500ms fetch spikes for keys with high contention. correlates with bursty traffic from a batch job in prod-analytics.
• kv-prefetch error rate: small uptick (0.8% -> 1.6%) on node group 12, retries are masking it. runbook note below.
• tokenizer OOM on a drained host (eu-west-1-host-9) — host is in draining state, no customer impact, but reducer task retries are noisy.

Marta: runbooks/quick checks:
• encoder pool: `kubectl -n inference exec -it svc/encoder-metrics -- curl localhost:9090/summary` to grab pod-level tail latencies.
• prefix cache spikes: check prefix-cache dashboards (dash: https://redwood.app/d/ops/prefix-cache) and correlate with `prod-analytics` job schedule.
• kv-prefetch: run `./scripts/kv_sanity_check.sh --group 12` (in ops repo), then increase prefetch retry backoff if errors persist.

Marta: owners — Sophia will cover first shift until 22:30 PT, Ryan covers after that. tagging @Nora for rotation at 02:00 if needed.

Alex: thanks — quick Q: is there a canary rollout for encoder changes currently?

Marta: no encoder rollouts in progress. the last rollout completed yesterday at 09:00 and rolled back automatically for 2% of traffic; we've been on stable since noon.

Sophia: taking the first shift. I'll check encoder pods and prefix-cache alerts in the next 20m. ping me if you see >2% error or >25ms tail increase.

Oncall Bot: automated summary — 8 alerts in last 4h: 5 info, 3 warning. top sources: prefix-cache (3), kv-prefetch (2), tokenizer OOM (1). (link: https://redwood.app/alerts/summary/1717502468)

Ryan: quick mitigation idea for kv-prefetch noise: temporarily raise prefetch backoff multiplier from 1.0 -> 2.5 for group 12 and monitor error rate for 30m. I can apply if Sophia wants.

Sophia: yes please do that if you see retries > 3. I'll monitor dashboards.

Nora: FYI — I'm on standby from 02:00–06:00 PT. if encoder latency worsens, consider draining suspect pods instead of full restart to preserve KV caches.

Marta: noted. small reminder: label any temporary changes with `ops:oncall-temp` and add a short PR or runbook note before removing.

Alex: re: prefix-cache spikes — can we throttle the prod-analytics job if it repeats? who owns that job?

Sophia: prod-analytics job is owned by data-team (cc @DataTeam in main). if it becomes repeatable noise I'll open a quick ticket and request a modest taper.

Marta: thanks team. leaving the watchlist in the handoff doc (https://redwood.app/handoffs/1717502468). small ask: if you mute an alert, add a brief note so we don't re-mute blindly. :white_check_mark:

Ryan: applying backoff change to kv group 12 now. will post results in ~10m.

Oncall Bot: action logged — `kv_prefetch_backoff_adjust` by Ryan at 1717503120.

Sophia: seeing immediate dip in kv errors to ~0.9%. nice. monitoring tail latency now.

Nora: acked. I'll take over at 02:00 if needed. good handoff, Marta.

Marta: thanks all — nothing else blocking. ping in-thread for updates so we keep a single source of truth. :handshake:
